answeredQuestions.core-problem: It is hard to evaluate and compare job opportunities consistently and efficiently.
answeredQuestions.target-users: A single user seeking to evaluate job opportunities before applying.
answeredQuestions.mvp-scope: A lightweight web app for entering opportunities, scoring fit, and reviewing saved evaluations.

referencesProcessed.keyFindings: The user wants a personal web app that evaluates job opportunities and helps decide whether to pursue them.

nextActions: Refine the scoring model and weighting options
